title: Young Couple In Front of House, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sharp black and white snapshot from the 1940s depicting a young man and woman standing together outside a brick home with an ornate carved wooden porch. The man wears a classic broad-lapel suit, tie, and slacks, while the woman is dressed in a dark winter coat and heels with a mid-1940s hair style. The bare tree limbs in the background indicate a cold season setting.
